title: Patch: Stinkyscape balance pass — Starship tag, Marketplace prices, Weapons and twenty cards
notes: The owner's balance pass #3000, built as a fullsend tree (#3038 to #3048) and reconciled by a Claude session: Starship becomes a tag with innate Flying and Ranged (R3038000), launches for (4), and the Drone Battleship's layers stop being Starships (R3038002); an awakened card is never Dormant again and a Flashback play keeps Flashback (R3039000, R3039001); every Weapon's Health halved and the Rush Token Launcher reaches a Locked zone (#3040); eight Stinkyscape cards (#3041), five more cards (#3042), True Craft a Card's points (#3043), Twinspell as an Activate (R3044000); a fused Miner or Weapon keeps its host's art and a Starship its name (R3045000), full art on the board (R3046000); the Marketplace's four offers, new prices, (0) buys and Buffed or Nerfed offers (R3047000 to R3047004); Echo's Coin fallback and Death by 1000 cuts' kept targets (R3048000 to R3048002). The AI scores a decision over a Starship by its hand evaluation (R3038003). With it, the owner's Stinkyscape balance pass IV, #3128 (#3134 to #3142), none of its cards one #3000 already moved: part 1 (#3134), Last Hurrah's counted discard (R3134000), Joint Filing's turn-hook pools (R3134001) and Heroic Power's Cry Discover of 3 of its 13 powers (R3134002); part 2 (#3135), the three Calls to Chaos and Appropriations each a step weaker (R3135000 to R3135002); part 3 (#3136), seventeen Core, Classic and Legacy cards' numbers and keywords; part 4 (#3138), twelve Meditative, Meditative+ and Classic+ cards' numbers and keywords, an embiggen card's Flashback offered at both its prices (R3138000); part 5 (#3139), eleven Core, Classic and Training Grounds scripts (R3139000 to R3139004), xxFreshJack and Shockwave447 playing differently as the BUSTED and complicated lists they draw from moved; part 6 (#3140), ten Meditative, Meditative+ and Classic+ scripts, Luck given by no card any more (R3140000), Mountaintop Garden's Cry (R3140001) and Conjure Rush Token+'s coin (R3140002); part 7 (#3142), sixteen Stinkyscape cards (Asphyxiants Cloud left as #3041 made it, by the owner's word), with Stimmycheck's Inflation step 5 (R3142000), MELCHIOR's random keywords (R3142001) and two new pictures (R3142002).

changes: Starship is now a tag, and every Starship, Dormant or launched, has Flying and Ranged.
The Drone Battleship's Shield, Propagation and Meltdown Layers are no longer Starships: they have Flying and Ranged, and Scornboi exiles them.
A card that awakens from Dormant is never Dormant again.
A card played by Flashback keeps Flashback, so it can be flashed back again.
The Marketplace offers 4 cards a turn: 8 Credits at (0), 15 at (1), then 10 more for each mana up to (4) and 15 more for each after that.
A card bought from the Marketplace costs (0), and some offers come Buffed, for more Credits, or Nerfed, for fewer.
A Resource card in your hand shows how many Credits it sells for this turn.
Twinspell is an Activate: the next Spell you play this turn gains Echo +1, then it goes to the graveyard. The Radiant one stays and works once a turn.
Echo has The Coin's text until a Spell has been played.
Death by 1000 cuts repeats by the mana you have left after paying for it, and every repeat hits the first target.
Drone Hanger summons its Drone Interceptor with an Activate instead of at the start of your turn.
ZolarKeth's second choice summons a random Starship Piece at the end of your turn instead of by an Activate.
Jlockeed's J15 Fighter has Can't Defend.
Jlockeed's Missile Pod rounds its damage up.
Asphyxiants Cloud has Flashback and deals 1 damage to all enemies (Radiant 2), and your next Spell this turn has Poisonous. It no longer draws.
Rush Token Launcher can summon its Rush Token into a Locked zone.
A Unit with a Miner or a Weapon fused into it keeps its own picture, and a Starship keeps its name as cards fuse into it.
Full-art cards look full-art on the board too, with their name below the picture.
Right-house defender has Can't Defend, and so do the ones House Party and The House summon.
System Schematic has Tradable and Flashback.
Sacked's Sack has Can't Defend.
Drone Commander fills your hand with random Drone Core cards, which no longer cost less, and is drawn as a human.
The Stinkyscape Golem is no longer a Starship Piece, and is drawn as a golem and a ship in one.
MELCHIOR's Activate gives each of your Units a random combat keyword instead of a Discover.
Palantir steals and casts a (2) Cost Spell, not a (1) Cost Spell.
Living Bomb's Cry places a Plague Counter; on its Radiant face an Activate does it instead.
Book of Plague lets you choose: place its Plague Counters, or add 3 random Plague cards to your hand (Radiant ones on its Radiant face).
Big Felinor destroys 3 random non-Felinor Units instead of all of them (on its Radiant face, enemy ones).
Snom Bunny Mind Control steals any enemy card on the field, not only a Unit.
Unbiased Immigration adds its random card with an Activate instead of at the start of your turn.
Masochism Mask makes your hand Radiant once you have taken 6 of its downsides, and again every 6.
Corpse Eater has Brittle 1 (Radiant Brittle 3), and after it attacks a Unit it may attack again.
Tutorial Master's Cry and Death add Training Grounds cards that no longer cost less.
Legacy: Snom Bunny Mind Control sets the stolen Unit's stats to 4/4, and its Radiant face steals any enemy card.
Last Hurrah discards 6 cards at the end of the turn instead of your whole hand.
Joint Filing gains a Cry: add a random card with a Start of turn or End of turn effect to your hand (Radiant: one of each).
Heroic Power lets you Discover one of 3 of its powers when you play it, instead of starting the game with a random one.
One of Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition)'s effects adds a random Call to Chaos at its own price at the start of each of your turns, instead of one at (0) now and every second turn.
Feng Shui no longer gives you Luck: its Activate adds an Auspicious Rock to your hand (a Radiant one on its Radiant face).
Jogg's Box ends your turn after its casts, and its Radiant face casts 20 random Spells, up from 10, with no Echo.
Conjure Rush Token+ flips a coin: its token gains 3 random combat keywords on heads and 2 on tails. Its Radiant face's tokens gain 5, up from 3.
Introspection acts at the start of your turn instead of the end.
Skull of J'Nari summons from your hand at the end of your turn instead of the start.
饕餮 fuses a random enemy Unit into itself, not any enemy permanent.
Money Machine gains a Cry: add a The Coin to your hand (a Radiant one on its Radiant face).
Mountaintop Garden gains a Cry: add a random Embiggen card to your hand, which costs (0) on its Radiant face.
Spirit Lash has Flashback.
Aestheticize the Game has Tradable.
